eas.schema: string subjectRef,uint32 runNumber,uint16 runRevision,bytes32 forecastId,bytes32 forecasterId,string forecasterLabel,uint64 forecastCreatedAt,uint64 anchorAt,uint64 anchorValueMicros,string target,string anchorUnit,string classification,bool retrospective,uint8 cadenceMonths,uint8 pointCount,string stepReturnBps,bytes32 receiptDigest

encodedFields.forecasterLabel: Ray Dalio / The Strategist / THINKER / Gemini 3.1 Pro

encodingSemantics.subjectRef: A compact scheme-prefixed market identifier; the full identifier bundle remains in receiptPayload bound by receiptDigest.
encodingSemantics.forecastId: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 source forecast ID.
encodingSemantics.forecasterId: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 stable source forecaster ID.
encodingSemantics.anchorValueMicros: Anchor observation multiplied by 1,000,000; 62684160000 means USD 62684.16.
encodingSemantics.target: The canonical predicted quantity; anchorUnit applies only to the underlying price anchor.
encodingSemantics.classification: Value from the ipulse-investment-rating-v1 scheme fixed by this projection version.
encodingSemantics.retrospective: True when the receipt is created for a forecast that was already published before the receipt workflow existed.
encodingSemantics.stepReturnBps: Comma-separated signed base-10 integers in forecast-step order; basis_points = source_percent * 100, so -400 means -4.00 percent.
encodingSemantics.schedule: Step n is anchorAt plus n times cadenceMonths; pointCount limits the path. This projection supports regular monthly cadence only.
encodingSemantics.receiptDigest: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical receiptPayload only. The proofEnvelope can gain attestation metadata without changing the sealed forecast payload.

calculatedSizes.note: ABI-encoded EAS data only; transaction envelope and execution gas are excluded.

derivationsNotStoredOnchain.explanation: These values are deterministically reconstructed from anchorAt, cadenceMonths, anchorValueMicros, and stepReturnBps.
